1. Introduction 
The India Trade Promotion Organisation (ITPO) is a premier trade promotion agency under the Government 
of India, organising national and international exhibitions, conferences and trade events at Bharat Mandapam, 
New Delhi. The immediate requirement for the aforementioned services is for 45th IITF, scheduled from 13th 
to 27th November, 2026. 
Through this RFP, ITPO intends to empanel an agency for its domestic events to provide an online registration 
portal generating mobile badges (m-badges) with unique QR codes, and to supply, personalise, laminate and 
distribute badges, for exhibitors, service providers, media, ITPO staff, government representatives and police 
personnel. Work shall be assigned event-wise through work orders. About 1,00,000 badges are expected for 
the 45th IITF; this figure is indicative only. 
2. Objectives 
• To provide an online registration portal with approval workflow, issuing m-badges with provided QR 
codes to the eligible categories. 
• To supply, personalise and laminate badges through kiosks, and distribute them at counters at the event

5. Scope of Work (SoW) 
For each ITPO domestic event for which a work order is issued, the empanelled agency shall provide an online 
registration portal, generate m-badges, supply, personalise and laminate physical badges through kiosks, and 
distribute the badges at the event venue, for the following categories: exhibitors, service providers, media, 
ITPO staff, government representatives and police personnel, and any other category specified by ITPO. ITPO 
shall provide covered space with furniture, raw power, the QR code specification, lanyards and API of its Gate-
Management System (where deployed), and general security.  
5.1. Registration Portal and m-Badge 
1.  The agency shall provide a mobile-friendly web portal with category-wise registration; login for 
exhibitors and organisations with badge quotas fixed by ITPO; bulk upload of lists by nodal officers 
(staff, government departments, police); OTP verification; upload of photograph and Government 
photo ID; de-duplication; and an approval workflow for the officers designated by ITPO. The portal 
shall be live within 7 (seven) days of the work order. 
2.  On approval, the portal shall generate an m-badge with a unique QR code provided by ITPO, with 
category-wise access validity (zones/halls/days) as decided by ITPO, and deliver it through SMS, e-
mail and/or WhatsApp. 
3.  The QR code shall be in the format specified by ITPO and, where a Gate-Management System is 
deployed, the data shall be pushed to it in real time through API. Integration testing shall be completed 
at least 2 (two) days before badge issue begins. 
5.2. Badge Supply, Personalisation, Lamination and Distribution 
1. The agency shall set up and operate kiosks (quantity as specified by ITPO) at the identified locations 
by ITPO, during the badge issue period specified in the work order. 
2. The agency shall supply PVC badges, 8.5 cm × 13 cm, 0.8 mm thick, glossy finish, printed in full 
colour  on  both  sides  with  the  event  logo  and  a  hologram,  and  personalised  with  the  holder's 
photograph, name and QR code, as per the design approved by ITPO, in the quantity specified in the 
work order. 
3. Each kiosk shall have a laptop / desktop, QR code scanner, a badge printer capable of printing on the 
PVC badges specified above and a laminator along with required stationery. On scanning the m-badge, 
the kiosk shall personalise the badge with the holder’s name, organisation, category, photograph, 
access zones and QR code, in the layout approved by ITPO, and laminate it, preferably within 60 
(sixty) seconds. Each kiosk shall be manned by two operators per shift, with at least 10% standby 
equipment  at  the  venue.  Any  additional  operators or  assistants required  for  personalisation  and 
distribution of badges shall be deployed by the agency, as per ITPO’s assessment, at no extra cost and 
within the rate quoted for operation and management of each kiosk. 
4. The agency shall operate a prescribed number of badge distribution counters at the locations identified 
by ITPO, with one staff member per counter per shift. 
5. Badges shall be handed over to the registrant, or to an authorised representative (exhibitor’s nominee 
or nodal officer) against an authorisation letter, after verification of the m-badge and photo ID. Every 
issue shall be recorded in the system, and bulk issues shall be made against signed acknowledgement. 
No badge shall be issued or reprinted without an approved registration; reprints and replacement of 
lost badges shall be made only with the approval of ITPO’s designated officer and logged in the 
system. 
5.3. Manpower 
1.  Besides the kiosk operators and counter staff, the agency shall deploy a minimum of 2 (two) IT Support 
Engineers per shift and one Team Leader as the single point of contact for each event. All personnel 
shall be in uniform with identity cards and police-verified; their list shall be submitted three (3) days 
before deployment.

2.  The agency shall pay wages not less than the applicable minimum wages and ensure all EPFO/ESIC 
related compliances. 
5.4. Reporting, Data Ownership and Handover 
1.  The agency shall provide ITPO a login to a real-time dashboard of registrations, approvals, badges 
personalised and badges distributed, and submit a daily MIS report by 12:00 hrs on the following day. 
2.  All data collected shall be the sole property of ITPO and shall be used only for this contract, in 
compliance with the applicable law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. The 
complete data for each event, including photographs and the badge issue register, shall be handed over 
to ITPO within seven (7) days of the conclusion of the event, and thereafter deleted from the agency’s 
systems, with a certificate of deletion. 
5.5. Exit & Default Conditions

exhibitors and organisations with badge quotas fixed by ITPO; bulk upload of lists by nodal officers

photo ID; de-duplication; and an approval workflow for the officers designated by ITPO. The portal 
shall be live within 7 (seven) days of the work order.

category-wise access validity (zones/halls/days) as decided by ITPO, and deliver it through SMS, e-
mail and/or WhatsApp.

deployed, the data shall be pushed to it in real time through API. Integration testing shall be completed 
at least 2 (two) days before badge issue begins.
